newsitem.title: USA: CalPERS says skeptical about ADM executive changes.
newsitem.headline: CalPERS says skeptical about ADM executive changes.

text.p: The California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS) said it was skeptical about management changes at Archer Daniels Midland Co since no outside individuals were named to top offices.
"We remain skeptical since there are no new individuals named," James Burton, CalPERS chief executive officer, said in a statement issued late Thursday.
On Thursday, ADM said it named a four-person office of the chief executive, a post that had been held solely by Chairman Dwayne Andreas.

The four-person office includes Andreas; James Randall, president; Charles Bayless, president of ADM's processing division, and G. Allen Andreas, who is counsel to the executive committee of the board of directors.
But CalPERS, an institutional shareholder with about 3.6 million ADM shares, said it will meet soon with ADM.
"We are very interested in learning what each person's new responsibilities are, and how each of these individuals will be held accountable by the board." Burton said.
